test.create_query: CREATE TABLE kv_short (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO kv_short SELECT concat('name:neymar', toString(number % 1000), ', age:31 team:psg,nationality:brazil, city:"Sao Paulo", id:', toString(number), ', extra:', repeat('x', 20)) FROM numbers(1000000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE kv_long_values (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO kv_long_values SELECT concat('k1:', repeat('a', 200), ' k2:', repeat('b', 200), ' k3:', toString(number)) FROM numbers(300000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE kv_very_long_values (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO kv_very_long_values SELECT concat('k1:', repeat('a', 2000), ' k2:"', repeat('b', 2000), '" k3:', toString(number)) FROM numbers(30000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE kv_log_lines (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO kv_log_lines SELECT concat('2024-01-01 12:00:00.123 [thread-', toString(number % 64), '] INFO Request processed user_id:', toString(number), ' method:GET path:/api/v1/items status:200 latency_ms:', toString(number % 500), ' ua:"Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64)" ok') FROM numbers(500000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE kv_many_tiny_pairs (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO kv_many_tiny_pairs SELECT arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('k', toString(i), ':', toString((number + i) % 10)), range(25)), ' ') FROM numbers(500000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE kv_no_pairs (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO kv_no_pairs SELECT repeat(char(97 + number % 26), 1000) FROM numbers(100000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE kv_escaped (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO kv_escaped SELECT concat('name:ney\\tmar', toString(number % 1000), ', path:C\\x3A\\\\Users\\\\', toString(number), ' text:"quoted \\"value\\" here", tab\\tkey:va\\nlue, id:', toString(number)) FROM numbers(1000000)
